validationOutcomes.detail: All 20 maintained ES sources plus six exact SOAR App, Export, related-product and Cloud records yielded usable official content. Source retrieval is not whole-page claim verification.
Ten consequence-prioritized checks; conflict and unknown states preserved. No factual correction to the ES dataset was justified.

validationOutcomes.check: Browser/current-legacy-shared-invalid URLs, keyboard, narrow screen, both themes, native PDF, independently reopened HTML, read-only WebMCP
validationOutcomes.detail: No product dataset, route/parser, page renderer, export generator, CSS, WebMCP or selected-state logic is changed. Those bytes must match reconciled baseline tree b805e4032724204d7eb1c2edf70e6af78e7ac7eb after generation. The October 7 owner-reported native PDF, independently reopened downloaded HTML and narrow-screen checks retain only their documented baseline scope; no fresh native pass is claimed.

validationOutcomes.check: Actual live ES route, legacy alias, Cisco theme, keyboard focus and WebMCP boundary
validationOutcomes.detail: The public current route rendered the 20-capability ES 8.7 comparison with five source questions, selected Cisco theme, history, Copy Link, Print/PDF and snapshot controls. The preview alias canonicalized to the same view, keyboard Tab focus reached the skip link, and the editions document exposed no WebMCP tools as designed.
